nodes.text: Three days in the mountains to chart the 2027 course, ship something silly, and eat too many s'mores.
Three days, three jobs to do
Leave with one plan we all wrote, three bets we all believe, and owners for each.
Two-day build, any team, any idea. Demo Friday morning. Prizes are real.
Remember why we like each other
Forty-two people, one long table, no laptops after dinner.
Lodge porch. Badges, trail maps, and the good espresso.
Priya and Sam walk the 2027 plan. Ten slides, zero spreadsheets.
One table, forty-two chairs, everything served family style.
Pick one: Product bets, Customer stories, or the AI test kitchen.
Choose the gentle lake loop or the summit scramble.
Dinner off the grill, stories by the fire, s'mores until late.

Night one ends
around the fire.
Aspen Creek Offsite  ·  Day one of three
Two minutes per team. Say what you are building and who it is for.
Teams of three to five. Any stack, any idea, no tickets.
Tacos on the dock. Swimming is allowed, strongly encouraged.
The lodge library is the quiet room. Mentors roam with coffee.
Commit, screenshot, breathe. Demos are tomorrow at nine.
Six rounds, one of them entirely about Ridgeline lore.

Night two is
trivia and hot cocoa.
Aspen Creek Offsite  ·  Day two of three
Every team, five minutes, live. Applause mandatory, questions kind.
Best build, best pitch, best name. Dana has the trophies.
We read the 2027 course back to ourselves and each owner says yes.
Boxed lunches for the road, group photo on the porch.
Cabin keys to the front desk. Lost hoodies go to the lodge box.
Wheels roll at 14:00 sharp. Back at HQ by 16:00.

Go home tired,
in the good way.
Aspen Creek Offsite  ·  Day three of three
A timber lodge at 2,600 metres with a lake, a library, a long porch and no reason to check Slack.
Two hours and twenty minutes from HQ by shuttle
Sixteen cabins, two to four beds
Assignments land in your inbox Friday before
Sessions, meals and the demo hour all happen here
Layers. Really. The porch gets cold after sunset
the porch is the best seat in the house
Three bets for 2027, argued and ranked. Bring an opinion and a customer story.
Twelve calls, twelve lessons. We read them together and pick the pattern.
Hands on with the new tooling. Break it, then tell us how.
sign up on the porch board
Keys, cabins, trophies and anything urgent.
Runs the 2027 plan sessions and the product bets track.
Build day mentor. Knows where the good coffee is.
AI test kitchen host and trivia quizmaster.
Shuttles leave HQ at 7:15 sharp and roll back Friday at 16:00. Driving yourself? Park behind the lodge and snap your spot.
Cabin assignments land in your inbox Friday. Check-in opens at 15:00; the front desk will happily hold bags before then.
Layers, trail shoes, a water bottle, and a swimsuit for the brave. Laptops stay home unless you are on call.
Wi-Fi is RIDGE-GUEST, password campfire26. For anything urgent, Dana holds the front desk and room 12.
No work Slack after dinner. The roadmap will keep; the campfire will not.
Questions? Post in #offsite-2026 or find Dana at the front desk.
Trail shoes that can get muddy
A book, a deck of cards, a ukulele
leave the laptop, bring the ukulele
Wheels roll at 7:15 and 14:00. The lodge is two hours out; nobody waits well.
Each session ends with a round. If you have not talked yet, you are next.
Notes on paper. Photos of the whiteboard are allowed at the end.
Demos are brave. Questions are curious. Nobody keeps score.

Bring a hoodie.
Bring an idea.
RSVP by September 2 so the lodge knows how many beds to make and how many s'mores to buy.
